d.ko: Live with the ever-present burden of being trapped in a time loop only you can know about in this turn-based RPG. Create a better future for you and your friends. Find hope where there is none left. Pray to the stars and free yourself from time.
d.en: Live with the ever-present burden of being trapped in a time loop only you can know about in this turn-based RPG. Create a better future for you and your friends. Find hope where there is none left. Pray to the stars and free yourself from time.
d.zh: 在这款回合制角色扮演游戏中，担负一直存在的、被困在只有自己知晓的时间循环的重负前行。为自己和朋友打造更美好的未来。找到已经荡然无存的希望。向繁星祈祷，从时间中解救自己。
